purpose: Deny-by-default promotion contract for moving only explicitly approved ORIGINAL v1 production assets into the standalone runtime.

source_track.note: The model branch is a candidate workspace. Never merge it wholesale into the standalone branch. Promotion must pin one explicitly approved source commit and exact production hashes.

approval_requirements: Every required gate must be set to approved or verified_production as appropriate before mode may become approved_for_promotion.
approved_source_commit must be one exact 40-hex commit from the isolated model branch.
Every production target must have one exact 64-hex SHA-256 and the repository file must match it byte-for-byte.
Production target names must not contain CANDIDATE, BASELINE, CORNER_FINAL, V9-V15, MakeHuman or other legacy/reference identities.
The standalone RELEASE_ASSET_ALLOWLIST.json must explicitly allow the exact release paths; broad character-directory or extension wildcards are forbidden.
male_character, male_shorts and canonical_rig must remain non-approved in FIRST_PARTY_COMPONENT_MANIFEST.json until the exact promoted assets and final rig have passed their production gates.
Promotion must copy only approved production artifacts/evidence. Do not merge the model branch into the standalone branch.
After promotion, rerun the full standalone, production-output, release, offline and browser/device acceptance gates on the exact resulting commit.

candidate_observation.note: Advisory snapshot only. It does not authorize promotion and may become stale as Blender work continues.
